integrity: The defining nonabelian embedding-tensor identity is reduced to an adjugate matrix equation. The arXiv-v1 and published versions were compared directly. A standalone checker exhaustively replays the full criterion over F2 and the finite-field count formulas.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the four-dimensional central 3-Lie algebra in Teng-Dai Example 2.8 with the coherent adjoint action.
The later published version already removes the invalid arbitrary-k arXiv-v1 family and retains the valid k=0 example.
title: Complete adjoint nonabelian embedding tensors on a four-dimensional central \(3\)-Lie algebra
